Organism: Anything 
living that is made of 
cells & needs energy, 
excretes wastes, 
grows, responds, 
reproduces, & uses 
gases.
 Examples: animals, plants, bacteria, 
fungi, protists, monerans
teachingNotes: Source uses Monerans, a historical classification term; retain as source vocabulary with clarification rather than presenting as an additional non-overlapping modern group.
Life processes describe life in general, not requirements that every individual perform every process at every moment.
The source says uses gases; do not rewrite this as all living things require oxygen.
